title: Mark Speakman resigns and says Liberals face ‘existential threat’ as NSW exodus continues
summary_full: Former NSW opposition leader warns party against becoming ‘Labor lite’ or ‘One Nation lite’ in late-night speechGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastFormer New South Wales opposition leader, Mark Speakman, will not contest his seat at the March state election, the latest in a mass exodus of MPs under the Liberal leader who replaced him, Kellie Sloane.In a late-night speech on Thursday, the final sitting day of NSW’s legislative assembly ahead of the vote, Speakman said he would not contest his south Sydney seat of Cronulla, which he has held since 2011.
